clue.text: Big bird servant pushed back, having got in the way

indicators.note: having got in says the turned servant is lodged within the word for way

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner of doing something

indicators.note: pushed back means the servant word is turned round to read the other way

parts.note: a page is a young servant or attendant

explanation.surface: A large bird's attendant is jostled backwards after getting in someone's path.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Big bird' reads like part of the surface, but it is the whole definition; 'pushed back' and 'having got in' are both instructions.
explanation.definitionFit: Megapodes are large-footed mound-building ground birds of Australasia, so a big bird fits.

clue.text: Servant has skimpy attire on

parts.note: a mini is a very short skirt or dress
taken as written

explanation.surface: A household servant is wearing scanty clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A minion is a subservient follower or underling, a synonym for servant.

clue.text: Fellow heartless, gaining speed in spin

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter of the fellow word is removed

parts.note: a guy is a man or fellow
rate means speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted man picks up pace as he twirls.
explanation.definitionFit: To gyrate is to spin or whirl round, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Basic standard the head voiced

indicators.note: voiced says the word for the head is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a principal is the head of a school or college

explanation.surface: A fundamental rule spoken out loud by the headteacher.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle is a fundamental truth or rule of conduct, a basic standard.

clue.text: Continues being naughty in rumba, maybe, creating upset

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters within the word for the rumba

parts.note: a rumba is an example of a dance

indicators.note: being naughty says the letters of continues misbehave and rearrange

explanation.surface: Someone keeps misbehaving during a rumba, causing distress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'creating upset' looks like a description of the scene; 'upset' is a verb here, the definition, and 'being naughty' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To discountenance is to disconcert or embarrass someone, which is to upset them.

clue.text: Tastes from hearty kisses

definitions.meaning: a thing that ... of something has a hint or flavour of it
loud enthusiastic kisses are ..., as in a smacker

explanation.surface: Flavours drawn from enthusiastic kissing.
explanation.definitionFit: Smack means a taste or flavour, and also a loud kiss; both senses take the plural here.

clue.text: Bit of crust good for mother to eat

indicators.note: to eat says the mother word takes the good abbreviation inside it

parts.note: mama is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: Mum is offered a piece of pie crust that is good to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Magma is molten rock which solidifies to form part of the Earth's crust.

clue.text: Cold Cockney man crossing the Alps, one eating what most of us wouldn't!

definitions.text: one eating what most of us wouldn't!

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap

indicators.note: Cockney speech drops the initial h, so the general's name loses its first letter

parts.note: Hannibal, the Carthaginian general, famously led elephants across the Alps

explanation.surface: A chilly Londoner crosses the mountains and eats something unusual.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney speakers, from London's East End, drop their aitches.
explanation.definitionFit: A cannibal eats human flesh, the food most of us would never touch.

clue.text: Surrey's opening speed merchants? They are out of this world!

definitions.text: They are out of this world!

indicators.note: opening picks the initial letter of the county name

parts.note: pacemen are fast bowlers in cricket

explanation.surface: Surrey cricket club's opening fast bowlers are simply brilliant.
explanation.walkthrough: Surrey is an English county with a famous cricket club; a cricket side's fast bowlers open the attack.
explanation.definitionFit: Spacemen are astronauts, who travel literally beyond the Earth.

clue.text: Amphibian disturbing a male red salmon

indicators.note: disturbing says the letters of the fish phrase are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A creature upsetting a male sockeye in the river.
explanation.definitionFit: The mole salamander is a burrowing North American amphibian of the genus Ambystoma.

clue.text: Nymphs, any number with inordinate desire

parts.note: N stands for an unspecified number in mathematics

indicators.note: inordinate means out of order, so the letters of desire are rearranged

explanation.surface: Nymphs of every count, filled with excessive longing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nereids were sea nymphs of Greek myth, daughters of Nereus.

clue.text: Fabric from South Africa backing paper maybe

indicators.note: backing means the South Africa code sits behind the paper word

parts.note: a newspaper is an organ, a publication speaking for a group
ZA is the international code for South Africa

explanation.surface: Cloth imported from South Africa is used to back paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Organza is a thin stiff sheer fabric of silk or synthetic fibre.

clue.text: Visual device behind the bar

definitions.meaning: a lens or other component of an instrument for seeing
a pub measure fixed to an upturned spirit bottle behind the counter

explanation.surface: A seeing gadget kept behind a pub counter.
explanation.walkthrough: In British pubs the spirit measure clipped to an inverted bottle is called an optic.
explanation.definitionFit: Optic relates to eyesight, so a lens is an optic; it is also the trade name for a pub spirit dispenser.

clue.text: Worker old theatre brought back with return of musical show

indicators.note: brought back means the theatre word is read in reverse

parts.note: rep is repertory theatre

indicators.note: return of means the musical's title is read backwards

parts.note: Evita is the Lloyd Webber musical about Eva Peron

explanation.surface: A worker at an old theatre revives a musical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' turns REP into PER; 'return of' turns EVITA into ATIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: An operative is a worker, especially one in a factory, or a secret agent.

clue.text: Marital arrangement to suit the unconventional man — ie a groper possibly?

definitions.text: Marital arrangement to suit the unconventional

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters given may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: An unorthodox setup for wedlock suits a man who likes groping.
explanation.definitionFit: An open marriage lets both spouses have other partners, an unconventional marital arrangement.

clue.text: Crises one somehow managed in economic decline

indicators.note: somehow managed says the letters of crises one are dealt with in some new order

explanation.surface: Crises were muddled through during an economic slump.
explanation.definitionFit: A recession is a period of contraction in economic activity, a downturn.

clue.text: A quiet relation readily understood

parts.note: taken as written
P, piano, is the musical notation for quiet
a parent is a close relation

explanation.surface: A quiet relative who is easy to make sense of.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparent means clearly visible or evident, plain to understand.

clue.text: Salt mined in Near East

indicators.note: mined suggests the letters of near east are dug up and broken apart

explanation.surface: Salt dug from the ground in the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: An arsenate is a salt or ester of arsenic acid, a chemical salt.

clue.text: For each act of separation tenacity is the answer

parts.note: per means for each, as in per head
severance is the act of cutting off or separating

explanation.surface: A homily: in every case of parting, sticking at it is the solution.
explanation.definitionFit: Perseverance is persistence in spite of difficulty, so it equals tenacity.

clue.text: Judge in province in forefront after uprising

indicators.note: in puts the province's letters inside the turned forefront word
after uprising says the forefront word is read upwards in this down light

parts.note: the lead is the forefront or front position
NI is Northern Ireland, a UK province

explanation.surface: A judge in a province leads the way after a revolt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after uprising' reads the forefront word upwards in this down light. Shylock hails Portia as 'a Daniel come to judgement'.
explanation.definitionFit: Daniel, the Bible prophet, judged wisely and became a byword for a wise judge.

clue.text: Soldiers accompanying a boy in grounds

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a body of soldiers
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: Troops accompany a lad on some playing fields.
explanation.definitionFit: Grounds means a justification or cause, a synonym of reason.

clue.text: Two articles on a married man in US collection

indicators.note: on means the two articles come after the married man in this across light

parts.note: taken as written
Eric is a man's name
an is the indefinite article
a is the other indefinite article

explanation.surface: Two items concern a husband in an American gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: Americana are artefacts relating to American culture, gathered as a collection.

clue.text: What gets things going with any number in terrible riot

indicators.note: in puts the number letter inside the jumbled riot letters
terrible signals that the letters of riot are badly mangled

parts.note: N stands for an unspecified number in mathematics

explanation.surface: Something that sparks off a dreadful disturbance with many people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' turns RIOT into ITRO, and 'in' places N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An intro is an introduction, the opening that starts a piece off.

clue.text: The external form of a European HQ

definitions.meaning: the outline or contour of something
the acronym for Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe, NATO's military command

explanation.surface: The outward look of a European headquarters building.
explanation.definitionFit: Shape is a figure or outline, and it is also NATO's Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe.

clue.text: Resilient men avoiding extremes ending in charge

indicators.note: avoiding extremes says to drop the first and last letters of men

parts.note: the last is the end of something

explanation.surface: Tough men steer clear of excess when finally put in command.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastic means springing back into shape, hence resilient or adaptable.

clue.text: Platform that is given the ultimate in gorgeous plants

parts.note: a dais is a raised platform
ie, id est, means that is

indicators.note: the ultimate in picks the final letter of gorgeous

explanation.surface: A stage decorated with the finest of lovely flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Daisies are common flowering plants with white petals around a yellow centre.

clue.text: Those people with nothing, British gangsters

parts.note: them refers to those people
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Penniless Britons turn to organised crime.
explanation.definitionFit: The mob is organised crime, the Mafia, a collective term for gangsters.

clue.text: Old landowner, loud and causing anger, no end

parts.note: F, forte, is the musical notation for loud

indicators.note: no end means the final letter of the anger word is dropped

parts.note: rankling means causing lasting resentment

explanation.surface: An old landowner was noisy and endlessly infuriating.
explanation.definitionFit: A franklin was a medieval English freeholder holding land but not of noble birth.
